# [CS024] Insecure TLS Configuration (tls-insecure-config)

TLS certificate verification is disabled or versions older than TLS 1.2 are allowed.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Severity** | HIGH |
| **Category** | Security |
| **CWE** | [CWE-295](https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/295.html) |
| **OWASP** | A04:2025 |
| **Auto-Fix supported** | Yes |

## Why It Matters in Go

InsecureSkipVerify accepts any certificate, so anyone on the network path can impersonate the server. TLS 1.0 and 1.1 have known weaknesses. --fix sets InsecureSkipVerify to false and MinVersion to tls.VersionTLS12.

## Vulnerable / Problematic Example

```go
cfg := &tls.Config{InsecureSkipVerify: true, MinVersion: tls.VersionTLS10}
```

## Safe / Idiomatic Go Pattern

```go
cfg := &tls.Config{MinVersion: tls.VersionTLS12, RootCAs: pool}
```

## Configuration & Suppression

Disable the rule for the whole module in `.codexsentinel.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  disabled: [tls-insecure-config]
```

Change its severity:

```yaml
rules:
  severity_overrides:
    tls-insecure-config: low
```

Suppress one reviewed finding on its line, with the reason:

```go
//codex:ignore tls-insecure-config -- <reason>
```

Or ignore it under a path in `.codexsentinel.ignore`:

```text
internal/legacy/** tls-insecure-config
```
